title: Respiratory Protection Program at Coal Mines
source_verification_depth: Complete Supporting Statement A plus package; underlying cited sources not all independently retrieved. Specific corroboration recorded separately.

score_rationale.reproducibility: Four activities with mine counts, frequency and exact minutes; burden totals reconstruct.
score_rationale.provenance: NAICS/SOC, OEWS2021, ECEC and ECI series and GDP index identified; older2019 population anchored to rule analysis.
score_rationale.segmentation: SOP revision, ASTM records, medical/fit tests and emergency inspections separate.
score_rationale.labor: Benefit and overhead factors explicit, but both ECI and GDP inflation appear applied over the same2021–22 period.
score_rationale.item13: No additional nonlabor cost asserted; exclusions to related controls are helpful but cost boundary incomplete.
score_rationale.item14: Routine inspection rationale for zero; incremental inspection time not quantified.
score_rationale.item15: New control and overlap exclusions clearly identified; zero-to-new bridge implicit.
score_rationale.validation: Administrative mine definition and agency experience; no measured four-hour timing evidence.
score_rationale.consistency: Main products reconcile with undisplayed precision; source-period typo and apparent duplicate inflation weaken defensibility.

assumptions: 1106 active2019 coal mines; active means at least520 employment hours in one quarter.
Four miners per mine; monthly emergency inspection; four annual SOP hours and four recordkeeping hours.

reconstruction_issues: Wages are updated with both2021–22 ECI and2021–22 GDP price factors; the statement does not justify applying both nominal changes.
Footnote names2012Q2 although the companion silica statement specifies2021Q2 for the same ECI ratio.
methods_worth_testing: Explicitly link related respiratory and silica obligations to distinct controls.
Preserve every inflation stage and test whether time periods overlap.
